title: Agent Loop: NativeDriver, Turn Execution, Steering, Follow-up
description:
Implement agent loop and NativeDriver from docs/plans/05-agent.md.

Sections: §5.1 (Turn Execution Algorithm), §5.2 (Steering Semantics), §5.3 (Follow-up Semantics), §5.4 (Terminal Tool), §5.5 (Snapshot Trigger Seam), §7.1 (RuntimeController Integration Contract)

Key deliverables:
- NativeDriver implementing AgentDriver (loop.go)
- Turn execution: snapshot conversation → transform → stream → tool execution → follow-up drain
- Provider event relay to canonical AgentEvents
- Steering injection at external call boundaries
- Follow-up queue with FIFO ordering
- Terminal tool short-circuit (no extra LLM continuation)
- Snapshot trigger seam: turn_completed + state_change(idle) events
- Public API: Prompt, Continue, Steer, FollowUp, Abort, Subscribe, Session (agent.go)
- Component tests with mock provider and fake tools
- Integration test with real provider (credential-gated)

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md
See Implementation Guide §1.4 (AgentDriver), §2.1 (Lifecycle Ordering), §3.1 (Snapshot Trigger), §4 (Common Pitfalls), §5 (Seam: ai.Provider ↔ agent NativeDriver)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/05-agent.md §5, §7.1
- Test harness: docs/plans/05-agent-test-harness.md
- Depends on: T1 (Agent Core Types)
